description: Header file defining functions for quantizing pulse positions in algebraic codebook encoding for AMR-WB codec.

methods.name: quant_1p_N1
methods.description: Quantizes a single pulse position, returning (N+1) bits.

methods.name: quant_2p_2N1
methods.description: Quantizes two pulse positions, returning (2*N)+1 bits.

methods.name: quant_3p_3N1
methods.description: Quantizes three pulse positions, returning (3*N)+1 bits.

methods.name: quant_4p_4N1
methods.description: Quantizes four pulse positions, returning (4*N)+1 bits.

methods.name: quant_4p_4N
methods.description: Quantizes four pulse positions, returning 4*N bits.

methods.name: quant_5p_5N
methods.description: Quantizes five pulse positions, returning 5*N bits.

methods.name: quant_6p_6N_2
methods.description: Quantizes six pulse positions, returning (6*N)-2 bits.
